description.value:
Rank 2 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 14 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Reaction, when a creature would succeed a saving throw against a Technique/Spell casted by you.
  • Range: Movement Speed
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: No

You take advantage of their focus in their success and go up to a creature, making an attack to set you up for the next one. Make a Combo Attack Roll, on a hit dealing your Weapon Damage Die + 1d10 Damage and the creature cannot react to the next attack from you or an allied creature.
